title: Retail Installment Contracts Fee Schedule: Computing the Late Charge on an Installment
content:
**Clause.** The late charge on an installment of a contract under Retail Installment Contracts is the product's late-charge percent of the scheduled installment, never more than the product's late-charge cap, rounded half-up to the cent.

**How the figure is assembled.** Every late charge on an installment is worked out in this order:

1. the reductions that apply to the charge are first added into one combined reduction percent (zero when none applies);
2. the late-charge rate is applied to the amount it applies to — the rate being the product's late-charge percent and the amount being the scheduled installment;
3. that product is reduced once by the combined reduction percent;
4. the reduced figure is compared with the product's late-charge cap and the lesser is taken;
5. the result is rounded half-up to the cent once, at the end.

The late charge is recorded with its installment due date set to the installment's due date. The scheduled installment is the contract's scheduled monthly installment amount.

| Quantity | Taken from |
|---|---|
| scheduled installment | the contract's scheduled monthly installment |
| late-charge percent and cap | the product's late-charge terms for the contract's tier |
| combined reduction percent | the reductions that apply, added together; zero when none applies |

**Worked example (hypothetical installment).** Scheduled installment 362.80; late-charge percent 5.0; cap 25.00; no reduction applying, so the combined reduction percent is zero. 5.0 percent of 362.80 is 18.14; reduced by zero percent it stays 18.14; the lesser of 18.14 and 25.00 is 18.14; rounded, 18.14.

**Second example (hypothetical, a reduction of 30 percent in total).** Scheduled installment 571.90 at 5.0 percent gives 28.595; reduced once by 30 percent it is 20.0165; below the 25.00 cap; rounded once at the end, 20.02. Rounding is not applied to the intermediate figures.
